title: Signal: Package entry accepting a pre-release band
scope: A packages.config file that declares an `allowedVersions` range that admits pre-releases.
limitations: It matches an `allowedVersions` range that admits pre-releases in the parsed packages.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A packages.config that mentions an `allowedVersions` range that admits pre-releases in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
